connector.name: Nyc Restroom MCP
connector.registryDescription: Find NYC public restrooms and their latest Parks inspection status, from NYC Open Data
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package nyc-restroom-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the danielortiz0220 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SOCRATA_APP_TOKEN
env.description: Optional NYC Open Data (Socrata) app token for higher rate limits

env.name: CORELOCATION_CMD
env.description: Optional path to the CoreLocationCLI binary for precise on-device location (macOS only; falls back to IP geolocation when absent)
